snippet.title: Melody XMAS Available for Free!
snippet.description:
We're thrilled to reveal that Melody XMAS by Big Bang Studio is now available for free on the Kagura Games Store at https://www.kaguragames.com/product/Melody-XMAS/

Melody Christmas is a 2D Arcade game featuring iconic internet VTuber Projekt Melody. Help Melody collect all the gifts before Malady steals all the presents for herself!
